definitions.INDEPENDENTLY_SUPPORTED: At least one line of evidence that does not use TESS pixels processed by this pipeline (ZTF recovery, or a Gaia DR3 spectroscopic-binary period equal to the TESS period or half/double it), and nothing against it.
definitions.TESS_ONLY_CLEAN: No independent line yet; cleanest TESS tier and no viable neighbour in the TIC or in Gaia.
definitions.TESS_ONLY_CAVEATS: No independent line yet, with at least one caveat. Candidate only.
definitions.DISFAVOURED: Evidence against: ZTF could have seen the eclipse and did not, or a TESS planet candidate.
definitions.KNOWN_ECLIPSING: Listed or labelled as an eclipsing binary elsewhere.
definitions.KNOWN_BINARY: Known as a spectroscopic or astrometric binary but not as eclipsing.
definitions.KNOWN_VARIABLE: Listed as a variable, possibly at another period.
definitions.NO_PRIOR_FOUND: Nothing found in the sources checked, which are not exhaustive.
